newsitem.title: USA: Harris sess no 1997 venture investments.
newsitem.headline: Harris sess no 1997 venture investments.

text.p: Harris & Harris Group Inc said Thursday that for at least the remainder of 1997, it does not expect to make investments in new venture capital opportunities, although it will continue to make follow-on investments in existing holdings as usual.
The group said Robert Schulz would resign as president and chief operating officer on February 14 and has been elected to the company's board as of February 5, 1997.
The company said Schulz will join a private venture capital partnership.
The president's title will be assumed by Charles Harris, the company's chairman and chief executive officer, the company said.
As part of the company's strategic realignment, it said it will emphasize new investments in small, publicly traded health care companies.
